import datetime
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import time

log_path, receipt_path, task_cwd = sys.argv[1:4]
command = sys.argv[4:]
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
clock = time.perf_counter()
with pathlib.Path(log_path).open('wb') as output:
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=task_cwd, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)

    'finished_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),

print(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False))
sys.exit(result.returncode)

import datetime
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess

root = pathlib.Path('/home/liuxuedeng/Django-Agent')
evidence = root / 'docs/refactor-evidence'
source_path = root / 'packages/core/src/retrieval/search-index.ts'
source = source_path.read_text()
start = source.index('    // Read current global occupancy once per chunk, preserving ordered release\n')
end = source.index('    if (chunk.seq_id===null)', start)
original = (
    "    const conflict = this.db.get('SELECT id FROM chunks WHERE seq_id=? AND id<>? LIMIT 1',rowid,chunkId);\n"
    "    const registered = this.db.get('SELECT chunk_id FROM retrieval_chunk_ids WHERE rowid=?',rowid);\n"
    "    if (conflict || registered && registered.chunk_id!==chunkId) throw new RetrievalError('seq_id_collision','Chunk seq_id collision cannot overwrite an index');\n"
    "    const previous = this.db.get('SELECT rowid FROM retrieval_chunk_ids WHERE chunk_id=?',chunkId);\n"
    "    if (previous && integer(previous.rowid)!==rowid) { this.db.run('DELETE FROM chunks_fts WHERE rowid=?',integer(previous.rowid)); this.#removeVectors(chunkId); this.db.run('DELETE FROM retrieval_chunk_ids WHERE chunk_id=?',chunkId); }\n"
)
baseline = source[:start] + original + source[end:]
baseline_sha = hashlib.sha256(baseline.encode()).hexdigest()
assert baseline_sha == '18f1bb38b52dad401400bac9b96ec519817ccde42b01dbcd51260113a33df65d', 'Unexpected shared source modifications'
own_diff = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(baseline.splitlines(keepends=True), source.splitlines(keepends=True),
    fromfile='baseline/search-index.ts', tofile='final/search-index.ts'))
owned = ['packages/core/src/retrieval/search-index.ts', 'packages/core/test/retrieval-keyword-id-publication.test.ts',
    'docs/desktop-refactor/KEYWORD-ID-PUBLICATION.md']

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

unmodified_expected = {
    'packages/core/src/retrieval/internal.ts': '43132403457efc7b147485776ee25a3b3a9c05b9822f2502a75d48ffa8a57b93',
    'packages/core/src/storage/database.ts': 'c344b9f94d7138361fd2e3320cfb07e9866eb05a193c5dcd998f880fb7cd7e4b',
    'packages/core/src/documents/pipeline.ts': '21b1beacc38ad987c1d33765eb566c78c0440b3a2540ddb399ce8683b1b262b0',
}
for relative, expected in unmodified_expected.items():
    assert sha(root / relative) == expected, 'Shared baseline changed: ' + relative

raw = {}
for path in sorted(evidence.glob('20261011-keyword-id-publication-*.tap')) + sorted(evidence.glob('20261011-keyword-id-publication-*.log')):
    text = path.read_text()
    summary = {}
    for key in ['tests', 'pass', 'fail', 'cancelled', 'skipped', 'duration_ms']:
        match = re.search(r'^# ' + key + r' (.+)$', text, re.MULTILINE)
        if match:
            summary[key] = float(match.group(1)) if key == 'duration_ms' else int(match.group(1))
    raw[str(path.relative_to(root))] = {'sha256': sha(path), 'tap_summary': summary}
receipts = {str(path.relative_to(root)): {'sha256': sha(path), 'receipt': json.loads(path.read_text())}
    for path in sorted(evidence.glob('20261011-keyword-id-publication-*-command.json'))}
final_tap = (evidence / '20261011-keyword-id-publication-related-final.tap').read_text()
diagnostics = [json.loads(line[2:]) for line in final_tap.splitlines() if line.startswith('# {')]

scripts = [pathlib.Path('/tmp/marlin-keyword-id-final-command-20261011.py'), pathlib.Path(__file__)]
archives = [{'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(path), 'content': path.read_text()} for path in scripts]
for path in scripts:
    path.unlink()
for archive in archives:
    archive['removed_after_archive'] = not pathlib.Path(archive['path']).exists()
remaining = [str(path) for path in pathlib.Path('/tmp').glob('marlin-keyword-id-publication-*')]
assert not remaining, 'Owned-prefix temporary fixtures remain'

for relative in owned:
    text = (root / relative).read_text()
    assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()), 'Trailing whitespace: ' + relative
    if relative.endswith('.md'):
        for link in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
            if link.endswith('20261011-keyword-id-publication-review.json'):
                continue
            assert (root / relative).parent.joinpath(link).exists(), 'Broken link: ' + link
diff_check = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check', '--', *owned], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
assert diff_check.returncode == 0, diff_check.stdout + diff_check.stderr
review = {
    'recorded_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'baseline_source_sha256': {'packages/core/src/retrieval/search-index.ts': baseline_sha},
    'source_sha256': {relative: sha(root / relative) for relative in owned},
    'unchanged_shared_source_sha256': unmodified_expected,
    'own_diff_against_exact_verified_baseline': own_diff,
    'raw_evidence': raw, 'command_receipts': receipts, 'final_diagnostics': diagnostics,
    'temporary_script_archives': archives, 'temporary_fixture_cleanup': {'owned_prefixes_only': True, 'remaining': remaining},
    'review': {'git_diff_check_exit': diff_check.returncode, 'owned_trailing_whitespace': False, 'documentation_links_exist': True},
    'result': {'new_test_red': {'pass': 4, 'fail': 1}, 'new_test_green': {'pass': 5, 'fail': 0},
        'related_final': {'pass': 61, 'fail': 0, 'cancelled': 0, 'skipped': 0}, 'typecheck_exit': 0,
        'association_reads_before': 390, 'association_reads_after': 130,
        'source_json_transfer_chars_before_and_after': 0, 'source_json_decodes_before_and_after': 0,
        'all_three_scalar_subqueries_use_indexes': True},
    'boundary': {'live_data_access': False, 'gui_access': False, 'credential_access': False,
        'real_model_or_configured_provider_calls': 0, 'isolated_local_http_fixture_tests_run': True,
        'cross_request_cache': False, 'new_database_writer': False, 'public_interface_changed': False,
        'full_core_suite_run': False, 'large_40000_ingestion_or_profile_run': False,
        'packaged_install_or_gui_performance_pass_claimed': False,
        'normalization_recursive_invocation_count_claimed': False,
        'overall_publish_local_speedup_claimed': False, 'committed': False},
}
output = evidence / '20261011-keyword-id-publication-review.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(review, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'review': str(output), 'review_sha256': sha(output), 'source_sha256': review['source_sha256'],
    'temporary_scripts_removed': all(archive['removed_after_archive'] for archive in archives)}, ensure_ascii=False))
